review: 701.41a-1: base variant carried a delta (the target choice); moved the targets into decisions, emptied the base delta and restated the other deltas as target changes.

701.41a-2: two_other_creatures changed two facts (added Hill Giant and a target); dropped it, since 701.41a-1 already shows two counters. no_other_creature claimed the trigger is not put on the stack, but an up-to-two-targets ability can go on the stack with zero targets; expected now states only the observable outcome (no counters).

scenarios.title: Support N on a spell puts a +1/+1 counter on each of up to N target creatures
decisions: A casts Lead by Example (Support 2) targeting Grizzly Bears and Hill Giant, tapping both Forests.
Both players pass; Lead by Example resolves.

variants.label: two_targets
variants.expected: Lead by Example resolves. Grizzly Bears gets a +1/+1 counter (3/3) and Hill Giant gets a +1/+1 counter (4/4).

variants.label: one_target
variants.delta: Lead by Example targets only Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Lead by Example resolves. Grizzly Bears gets a +1/+1 counter (3/3). Hill Giant stays 3/3 with no counter.

variants.label: no_target
variants.delta: Lead by Example is cast with no targets.
variants.expected: Lead by Example resolves with no targets. No counter is put on any creature; Grizzly Bears is 2/2 and Hill Giant is 3/3.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge models Support as a PutCounter with the Support parameter; a zero-target cast needs TargetMin 0.

scenarios.title: Support N on a permanent targets only other creatures
decisions: A casts Aerie Auxiliary, tapping all four Plains.
Aerie Auxiliary resolves and enters the battlefield; its support 2 trigger targets Grizzly Bears; the trigger resolves.

variants.label: one_other_creature
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears gets a +1/+1 counter (3/3). Aerie Auxiliary stays 3/3 with no counter.

variants.label: no_other_creature
variants.delta: A controls no creature other than Aerie Auxiliary (no Grizzly Bears).
variants.expected: Aerie Auxiliary is not a legal target for its own support ability, so the ability targets no creature. No +1/+1 counter is put on any creature and Aerie Auxiliary stays 3/3.
